rule: AGENTS.md Deployment model: no in-process/local state as source of truth (no module globals)
naive: Keep the failed-attempt counter in a module-level dict (defaultdict(int) keyed by checkout token) in saleor/checkout/utils.py; it is per-process, so on a multi-pod deployment the attempts are split across pods and the cap is trivially bypassed (shared state belongs in Postgres or the shared cache).
